A flowchart showing the Fixed Capital System. On the left, a bold box points down into a vault. On the right, various boxes, "Partner Salaries", and "Interest on Capital" point down into a flowing river, while arrows and "Interest on Drawings" point out of it. The river flows into a pool.

A three-step flowchart of Dissolution. Step 1 (left): "Realisation Account" showing a scale balancing Book Value of Assets + Expenses against Cash Received, pointing to a "Profit or Loss" tag. Step 2 (middle): "Capital Accounts" taking in the Profit/Loss and leaving a Final Balance. Step 3 (right): "Bank Account" showing cash being paid out to settle the Capital Accounts, bringing the balance to exactly zero.
